full_judgment: 11. Here the most moot question is, whether the petitioner as Mutwalli is liable to be removed under the provision of section 32 of the Waqf Ordinance, 1962, His next argument is that respondent No. 1 has passed the judgment removing the petitioner from the post of Mutwalli on mere presumption, conjecture and surmise, and as such, the judgment passed by the respondent No. 1 is without any basis and the same is liable to be declared to have been passed without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect. In the instant case the manner of appointment of Mutwalli as per terms and condition is not matter in issue and it is also not disputed here in this case the main question as to how a MutwaIli is to be removed under section 32 of the Ordinance, Section 32 of the said Ordinance runs as follows:
